name: BIG-Bench-Hard-cot-prompts
description: A collection of chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting templates for the difficult tasks in BIG-Bench-Hard, intended to evaluate and improve models' multi-step reasoning via guided intermediate reasoning steps. It is used to test whether CoT-style few-shot prompts boost performance on hard reasoning problems across diverse BBH tasks. The dataset provides human-crafted CoT exemplars for prompting rather than standalone question/answer pairs.
reputation: Well-known in the research community for probing reasoning and prompting techniques, frequently used in prompting and chain-of-thought studies.
